propositions: compact.py is 798 LOC (near 800-LOC cap) with CCN 24 and 21 in two functions, flagged for size and complexity; it must be split into a CLI facade over two extracted engines by responsibility

The split requires compact_txn.py (transaction + shared snapshot primitives) and compact_rebuild.py (snapshot reconstruction), with shared helpers in compact_txn to avoid circular imports between the two new modules

Public APIs and test imports must be preserved via re-exports from compact.py; consumers in fsck_repair.py, fsck_restore.py, and multiple test files must continue to import through rebar._commands.compact without edits

The rebuild counter (_REBUILD_COUNT and get_rebuild_count) must live in compact_rebuild.py with its incrementer to ensure rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log reads the correct module global, not a different stale instance
Two monkeypatch seams in test_compact_negative.py must be repointed from the facade to the new homes (compact_txn._git; compact_txn.lock) because the split moves the symbols those tests patch
A new test must prove counter co-location by calling rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log on a real ticket and asserting get_rebuild_count() strictly incremented, covering a gap in the existing test suite
